description: The Cinder-brand's head broken off and set on a haft of titan iron at Last Hearth's forge: a mass of fused slag and iron that never quite goes cold. Its heavy blows set what they strike burning, and a foe already burning takes them harder.

perk.text: Heavies set what they strike burning for 8 s; a foe already burning takes them 35% harder (damage and poise)
